lead: Before writing a depth case, read the landed neighbour's whole `--FILE--`, not the handoff's summary of it.
body: A handoff item is written by a session that had the module open and the neighbour case closed, so its summary of a landed file is the part most likely to be stale; one said a case "feeds two chunks" when it swept five widths across four subjects. The uncovered claims are the ones the landed case's own text does not make, and only its text says which those are.
